character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After surviving Commander Vance's ambush and the cavern collapse, Kael confronted the crimson abyss and absorbed a devastating shockwave that merged the mysterious entity with his nervous system. Tracking a new anomaly, he was ambushed in his hideout by a shadowy operative wielding identical powers, culminating in a sudden floor collapse that plunged them both into an unknown abyss.
